scripts.speaker: Munster
scripts.text:
My family used to live in Geffen. So I guess it was natural that we studied forging and eventually became Blacksmiths. Then, we finally moved to this town,
Al De Baran.
About ^3355FFItem Upgrade^000000
Quit

scripts.speaker: Munster
scripts.text: My father was a famous blacksmith in Geffen, and he taught me a lot about forging equipment.

scripts.speaker: Munster
scripts.text: One of the fundamentals is that the success probability of upgrading an item depends on the level of the weapon.

scripts.speaker: Munster
scripts.text: For level 1 weapons, you may upgrade up to + 7 without the risk of breaking the weapon. Level 2 weapons can be upgraded to +6. Level 3 weapons can be upgraded to +5 safely.

scripts.speaker: Munster
scripts.text: For level 4 weapons, you can upgrade + 4 without too much risk. As for armors, you can upgrade them to +4. But if the upgrade for the equipment fails, it will be destroyed!

scripts.speaker: Munster
scripts.text:
Hmm...
If you get a chance, try to visit my father's workshop here in Al de Baran. If I may say so, he's a pretty talented Blacksmith.

scripts.speaker: Quatro
scripts.text: Have you heard that a famous Blacksmith moved here from Geffen?
Famous Blacksmith?
End Conversation

scripts.speaker: Quatro
scripts.text: From what I've heard, he's one of those Blacksmiths that can upgrade your weapons and armor. When you upgrade a weapon, its attack strength is increased.

scripts.speaker: Quatro
scripts.text: For each upgrade level, attack strength increases by 2 for level 1 weapons. On level 2 weapons, 3 attack strength is added.

scripts.speaker: Quatro
scripts.text: On level 3 weapons, 5 attack strength is added for each level, and for level 4 weapons, 7 attack strength is added for each level.

scripts.speaker: Quatro
scripts.text: This Blacksmith's family lives here, since his wife is sick and weak. Because of her condition, she needs to take medicinal herbs that grow near Al de Baran.

scripts.speaker: Quatro
scripts.text: They also have a dutiful son who's always helping out with the family business. I'm sure that kid will grow up to become a good Blacksmith like his father.

scripts.speaker: Miller
scripts.text:
Aren't level 4 weapons cool!
I can't believe such powerful
weapons exist!

scripts.speaker: Miller
scripts.text: Well, they're rarely seen in the open market, but boss monsters will drop them by a low chance if you happen to be able to kill them.

scripts.speaker: Joanne
scripts.text: I enjoy gathering shells from the sea. It's really fun and relaxing~
Shell Gathering?
End Conversation

scripts.speaker: Joanne
scripts.text: When you see bubbles popping up from the sand or muddy puddles, try digging into the ground a bit. You might find some shells underneath the ground!

scripts.speaker: Joanne
scripts.text:
Have you heard
of Ambernite?
That shell monster
is pretty tough~

scripts.speaker: Joanne
scripts.text: It's usually seen at the beach near the west province of Prontera. If you ever try attacking it without being prepared, you might be in trouble.

scripts.speaker: Joanne
scripts.text:
Ambernite is
pretty strong!
So look out for it!

scripts.speaker: Joanne
scripts.text:
Ambernite is
pretty strong!
So look out for it!

scripts.speaker: Panama
scripts.text: Al De Baran is known world wide as the City of Canals. The waterways really add a sophisticated, romantic touch to our fair city.
About the Canals
End Conversation

scripts.speaker: Panama
scripts.text:
Well, a canal is an artificial waterway used for travel,
shipping, or irrigation.

scripts.speaker: Panama
scripts.text: However, the canals over here are just for show. If we needed to transport anything, we just use the Kafra Corporation Teleport service!

scripts.speaker: Panama
scripts.text: I have that you will enjoy your stay in Al De Baran.

scripts.speaker: Isenberg
scripts.text:
Mt. Mjolnir and Payon Forest.
Both of those places are tough
to travel through.
Mt.Mjolnir?
Payon Forest...?
End Conversation

scripts.speaker: Isenberg
scripts.text: To arrive here from Prontera or Geffen, you've got to cross the Mjolnir Mountains.

scripts.speaker: Isenberg
scripts.text:
If you've made it here by foot without using the Kafra Teleportation service,
then good job!

scripts.speaker: Isenberg
scripts.text: The Mjolnir Mountains are really steep, and it's full of aggressive and hostile monsters. So it's always a risk to travel through there alone.

scripts.speaker: Isenberg
scripts.text: If you wish to visit Alberta or the city of Payon, you must first travel through the Payon Forest.

scripts.speaker: Isenberg
scripts.text: The Payon Forest is a winding, intricate maze where it's easy to get lost. Unless you concentrate and keep track of your path, you might be stuck wandering in that dangerous place.

scripts.speaker: Isenberg
scripts.text: Payon, the Archer Village, was built deep inside this steep and rugged forest so that it may be protected from outside invaders. So I guess that a good decision on their part.

scripts.speaker: Isenberg
scripts.text:
The huge mountains surrounding this town
blocks people from outside to come into this town.
That may be a part of the reason how we have been able to
keep this beautiful canal and mysterious alchemy
without any influence from outside.

scripts.speaker: Epthiel
scripts.text: Some weapons or armor have Slots where you can insert Cards obtained from monsters.
About the number of Slots
Relation between Cards and Slots
End Conversation

scripts.speaker: Epthiel
scripts.text: Items dropped by monsters possess more Slots than ordinary weapons or armor sold in NPC shops.

scripts.speaker: Epthiel
scripts.text: I guess you can assume that an item with more Slots is more valuable than the same item with fewer Slots.

scripts.speaker: Epthiel
scripts.text: Once a Card is inserted into a Slot, it is impossible to remove it. So please be careful when you insert Cards into weapons or armor.

scripts.speaker: Epthiel
scripts.text: Also, when you mouse over equipment in the Item Window or Vending Window, the name of the item will be followed by the number of its Slots in brackets.

scripts.speaker: Epthiel
scripts.text: For example, a Shield with 1 Slot, when moused over, would display the name 'Shield [1].'

scripts.speaker: Epthiel
scripts.text: You may also right-click an item, and check the Card Slot window below the item description window for the number of Slots.

scripts.speaker: Epithiel
scripts.text: Have you ever obtained a card from a monster?

scripts.speaker: Joy
scripts.text: Level 1 weapons, which are the lowest grade, need a metal named ^3355FFPhracon^000000 in order to be upgraded.
About Phracon
Advice about Phracon
End Conversation

scripts.speaker: Joy
scripts.text: Phracon is a pretty common metal and can be found all over the Midgard continent.

scripts.speaker: Joy
scripts.text: Although it lacks the strength of other metals, it's easy to find and obtain. You can get Phracons by killing monsters or by buying them in Forging Shops in towns.

scripts.speaker: Joy
scripts.text: When you no longer need Phracons because you are using higher level weapons, you can sell them for some zeny!

scripts.speaker: Joy
scripts.text: Well, I hear lots of monsters carry Phracons and will drop them once killed. Why don't you go hunting for them?

scripts.speaker: Joy
scripts.text: It shouldn't be too difficult. Once I found a Phracon that dropped after killing a Bebe Savage! But if you're desperate, you can always buy them at the Forging Shop.

scripts.speaker: Joy
scripts.text: Good luck with finding Phracons!

scripts.speaker: Chemirre
scripts.text: Alchemists, one of the 2nd Jobs, are able to create items out of several materials using knowledge from the ancient age of Al De Baran.
About Alchemy in Payon
Definition of Alchemy
End Conversation

scripts.speaker: Chemirre
scripts.text: Most people don't know that there was an oriental form of Alchemy that developed in Payon.

scripts.speaker: Chemirre
scripts.text: These Payon Alchemists were able to create Gold out of different materials. However, Payon Alchemy never advanced as much as the Alchemy in Al De Baran.

scripts.speaker: Chemirre
scripts.text: Materials for Alchemy in Payon were scarce and interest in that field eventually waned. Now, you can only study Alchemy here in Al De Baran.

scripts.speaker: Chemirre
scripts.text: Still, I can't help but wonder what secrets were lost after the Payon art of Alchemy disappeared from the face of the Earth...

scripts.speaker: Chemirre
scripts.text: Alchemists specialize in chemical research in order to create useful items out of various things.

scripts.speaker: Chemirre
scripts.text: I also hear that they create all sorts of Potions, and can even summon certain monsters! It seems that their studies have all sorts of nifty applications.

scripts.speaker: Chemirre
scripts.text:
You are bored, aren't you?
Alright then, I will tell you a story about monster cards and item slots.
As you already know, if you ever have obtained a monster card before,

scripts.speaker: Chemirre
scripts.text:
you can only insert a monster card to an item
that satisfies the card's location requirement.
For instance, let's say, you have obtained a Poring Card.

scripts.speaker: Chemirre
scripts.text:
When you right click on the card, you will see
its ability as LUK+2 and Perfect Dodge+1
and its location as 'Armor'.

scripts.speaker: Chemirre
scripts.text:
If you try to insert this card to a dagger with many slots,
it is not going to work because the card only can be inserted to
armor items.

scripts.speaker: Chemirre
scripts.text:
Almost every armor items that are being sold
in town shops do not have slots on them.
That means, you can only obtain
slotted armors by hunting monsters.

scripts.speaker: Chemirre
scripts.text:
Ah, let me tell you how you can insert a card to an item.
If you want to insert a card on your equipped armor,
you must unequip the armor first.
And then, double click a card that you want to use.
Then a list of armor, that you can insert the card, will be displayed.

scripts.speaker: Chemirre
scripts.text: It is not that complicated, is it?

scripts.speaker: Chemirre
scripts.text:
You can talk about Rune-Midgarts' alchemy
without talking about the Al De Baran Alchemist Guild!
Long Live Alchemists!

scripts.speaker: Bebe
scripts.text:
A while ago I went out for a walk toward Mt. Mjolnir with my pet Savage Bebe. His name is NukNuk!
We got attacked, but luckily we weren't hurt.
Attacked?
About Mt.Mjolnir
End Conversation

scripts.speaker: Bebe
scripts.text: I was walking up a narrow path, and out of the blue, a giant and ugly plant started to attack me and NukNuk!

scripts.speaker: Bebe
scripts.text: I was so surprised, so me and NukNuk had to run away. I threw rocks at it, but I don't think I hurt it. It must have been really strong!

scripts.speaker: Bebe
scripts.text: What really surprised me was the plant that attacked me was a huge flower with the face of a person! So, look out for those. They're dangerous!

scripts.speaker: Bebe
scripts.text: Even though people are fascinated by the scenic beauty of Mt. Mjolnir, it's full of dangerous monsters!

scripts.speaker: Bebe
scripts.text: There are Flowers, Insects, Bees, Butterflies and Moths that are big enough to kill you if you're not careful!

scripts.speaker: Bebe
scripts.text: Then again, most of these monsters won't hurt you if you don't attack first. But some of them will attack you once they see you!

scripts.speaker: Bebe
scripts.text:
By the way, where is my NukNuk...?
NukNuk! Come out!

scripts.speaker: Stromme
scripts.text: Even to a strong Swordman, the Insects or Mt. Mjolnir pose a considerable threat. You've got to know your enemy before engaging it in battle!
About Insects
End Conversation

scripts.speaker: Stromme
scripts.text: Honey Bees, Butterflies and Moths seem like simple creatures, but that doesn't mean you should underestimate them.

scripts.speaker: Stromme
scripts.text: These Insects have evolved over time, and can counter attacks from threats like you adventurers!

scripts.speaker: Stromme
scripts.text: There are also carnivorous Insects, such as praying Spiders, praying Mantises, and the millipede like Argiopes.

scripts.speaker: Stromme
scripts.text: These monsters have mutated and are too strong for a person at certain levels. You should especially watch out for Argiopes.

scripts.speaker: Stromme
scripts.text: Luckily, their eyesight is pretty bad, so it won't notice you if you walk a safe distance away from it.

scripts.speaker: Stromme
scripts.text:
No matter how harmless and pretty insects are,
take heed to not touch them.
They are extremely strong unlike their innocent looking.
Don't belittle the livings in the Mt. Mjolnir.

scripts.speaker: Sylvia
scripts.text: I came all the way here from Prontera because I heard the Kafra Main Office was somewhere here in Al De Baran.

scripts.speaker: Sylvia
scripts.text: It shouldn't be that hard to find, but I'm awful at following directions. I always get lost, no matter how hard I try!

scripts.speaker: Sylvia
scripts.text: If that wasn't bad enough, I left my Magnifiers back in Prontera, so now I have to find someone to help me with these weapons I've got to appraise!
Appraise?
That's very nice.

scripts.speaker: Sylvia
scripts.text: Equipment that is dropped by monsters can't be equipped right away.

scripts.speaker: Sylvia
scripts.text: If you right-click the equippable item in the Item Inventory, you'll see that it is Unidentified and that Appraisal is needed. What to do?

scripts.speaker: Sylvia
scripts.text: Well, in that case, you've gotta use ^3355FF Magnifier^000000!

scripts.speaker: Sylvia
scripts.text: Even without a Blacksmith, Alchemist or Merchant in your party, you can appraise your equipment! Of course, a Magnifier is consumed each time you use one...

scripts.speaker: Sylvia
scripts.text:
Hey...
Was that a hint of sarcasm in your voice when you said that?

scripts.speaker: Issei
scripts.text: Al De Baran is such a wonderful place with its romantic canals and classic architecture. I love nothing more than to stroll through this city with my beautiful girlfriend.
You have a girlfriend?
End Conversation.

scripts.speaker: Issei
scripts.text:
Hey...
Is that so hard to believe?! Yeah, ask anyone! She really exists! Although, sometimes, just sometimes mind you, she gets too excited about weapons and armor.

scripts.speaker: Issei
scripts.text: I mean, instead of enjoying a romantic dinner, she'll just go on about how equipment dropped from monsters is higher quality than those sold in shops...

scripts.speaker: Issei
scripts.text: I mean, why should I care if equipment dropped by monsters tend to have more Slots?! I can't even kill a Poring!

scripts.speaker: Issei
scripts.text:
As you can see,
I'm a lover,
 not a fighter.

scripts.speaker: Issei
scripts.text: So, you don't think of me stupid, do you?

scripts.speaker: Joo Jahk
Joo Jahk
scripts.text: The tempature here in Al De Baran is very cool, probably because of the waterways. Do you think the water in the canals is drinkable?

scripts.speaker: Joo Jahk
scripts.text: Well, it's too late for me, since I already drank some. Still, I'm a little worried...
Continue.
End conversation.

scripts.speaker: Joo Jahk
scripts.text: On one of my travels around Midgard, I've heard from a really high level Mage that physical attacks, or magic with Neutral Property, won't damage Spiritual Property monsters.

scripts.speaker: Joo Jahk
scripts.text: Maybe that advice will come in handy, now that you know that. Always remember the importance of the Properties of your skills and weapons when battling monsters.

scripts.speaker: Joo Jahk
scripts.text: On the other hand, the water I drank did taste pretty good. Hopefully it didn't have anything too weird in it...

scripts.speaker: Gavin
scripts.text:
Welcome!
The town of
Al De Baran
welcomes you!

scripts.speaker: Gavin
scripts.text:
Well, that might be an exaggeration. After all, it's just me that's welcoming you.
Hey there!
Now, tell me about monsters.
End conversation.

scripts.speaker: Gavin
scripts.text:
Monsters...?
Aren't we straying off topic a little bit? Ah, you must be one of those adventurers!

scripts.speaker: Gavin
scripts.text: Can't get your mind off the job, eh? Alright, now there was some monster that I saw just recently...

scripts.speaker: Gavin
scripts.text: Ah, now I remember! Just a few days ago, I saw a really interesting looking monster! It was a Poring with Angel's wings!

scripts.speaker: Gavin
scripts.text: I swear! He was jumping around somewhere near Mt. Mjolnir with some ordinary Porings. I think he was, like, their leader.

scripts.speaker: Gavin
scripts.text:
Awww...
Don't be too disappointed that there's only one person in your welcome wagon!

scripts.speaker: Nastasia
scripts.text: Somewhere in the world there is an ^3355FFAssassin Guild^000000, where they teach people the subtle art of assassination.

scripts.speaker: Nastasia
scripts.text: But isn't killing illegal? And do they even collect educational tuition?
Continue conversation.
End Conversation.

scripts.speaker: Nastasia
scripts.text: Although Assassins benefit from being very quick and having lots of AGI, they should still have some DEX.

scripts.speaker: Nastasia
scripts.text: DEX is especially important if you want to hit monsters with wings. Those monsters are quick moving and fast in attacking.

scripts.speaker: Nastasia
scripts.text: In general, if you want to hit monsters that are as fast, or even faster, than you are, you're going to need some DEX.

scripts.speaker: Nastasia
scripts.text: It's usually said that in this world, nothing is free. Still, if you don't have to pay money to learn to be an Assassin...

scripts.speaker: Bell Keeper
scripts.text: I have been charged by the Committee of 'Heaven on Earth' to guard this entrance of the Clock Tower.
About Clock Tower.
Quit.

scripts.speaker: Bell Keeper
scripts.text: Every floor of this tower is connected to each other by a certain device we like to call 'Warp Gear.'

scripts.speaker: Bell Keeper
scripts.text: Even though there are interconnecting warps everywhere in the Clock Tower, beware the 'Random Warp.'

scripts.speaker: Bell Keeper
scripts.text: The 'Random Warp' will transport you to an unknown spot. Be advised if you don't want to suddenly be separated from your party...

scripts.speaker: Bell Keeper
scripts.text: Remember, Random Warps are shown in green on the mini-map. So keep your eyes peeled for that, as well as for those dangerous Clocks.

scripts.speaker: Bell Keeper
scripts.text: Please take heed that this Clock Tower is filled with extremely dangerous monsters.

scripts.speaker: RS125
scripts.text:
I may sound inhuman rather robotic
however, I hope you will not be afraid of me. I am as humane as you are.

scripts.speaker: RS125
scripts.text:
I may have a machine heart and I may disturb you with loud noises from the heart,
that will never stop me from running for future of Al De Baran.
Listen to his story.
End Conversation

scripts.speaker: RS125
scripts.text:
It's been 3 years already.
My brother 996 used to be a short track athlete in the Al De Baran city field team.
Back then, people gave him a nickname, 'Al De Baran's Peco Peco',
for his amazingly fast legs...

scripts.speaker: RS125
scripts.text:
He became so popular for his exciting play,
so every time when the 'Al De Baran Turbo Track' was held once every 4 years,
many people from all over the continent came to this city only to see my brother.
I was his manager at the time and I was so stressed out because of his fans.

scripts.speaker: RS125
scripts.text:
However, there is nothing last forever...
One day, a girl from Payon beat my brother from a game.

scripts.speaker: RS125
scripts.text:
My brother couldn't accept the fact that he lost the game
so he did too much of practice and had a serious heart attack.
He is still in bed.

scripts.speaker: RS125
scripts.text:
I am my brother's only hope and the future of Al De Baran!
Please wish me luck, I will beat her, 'Breezy Havana' from Payon!

scripts.speaker: RS125
scripts.text:
I want to travel around the world one of these days.
If I can see the ocean from the port of Alberta, it must be so wonderful.
After the next year's athletic competition, I will go on a round-the-world tour with my brother.

scripts.speaker: Threatening-Looking Man
scripts.text:
Hey, you don't come inside someone else's house without permission.
This is ridiculous!
How dare you to come inside of my house and talk to me as if that is a normal thing to do?

scripts.speaker: Threatening-Looking Man
scripts.text: Hahahaha...chill out, I was just joking.
Continue
Quit

scripts.speaker: Threatening-Looking Man
scripts.text:
You may know this already, but
we have a system called, the mercenary system in this world.
Yes, I am a mercenary soldier.

scripts.speaker: Threatening-Looking Man
scripts.text:
It is simple. You just pay for someone to aid you in fight.
Better mercenary soldier you want, more money you have to pay, you know?

scripts.speaker: Threatening-Looking Man
scripts.text:
Let's stop talking about boring stuffs.
I will tell you how you can find a good mercenary soldier.

scripts.speaker: Threatening-Looking Man
scripts.text:
Check its nose if it is clean and wet.
A good mercenary soldier must have the wet nose
because it shows that the soldier is at his best in health condition.
If the nose is dry, that means that he caught a cold.

scripts.speaker: Threatening-Looking Man
scripts.text:
And don't forget to check the soldier's ankle.
The best mercenary soldier has thin ankles and a white neck!
If he has long hair, it's better! If the hair is permed and wavy, that's perfect!

scripts.speaker: Threatening-Looking Man
scripts.text:
Lastly, you have to check whether he is ready to serve you with quality service!
That means, he must do his best in aiding you in fight!

scripts.speaker: Threatening-Looking Man
scripts.text:
Get out, now!
If you a cop, show me a warrant,
if you are a member of my family, prove it with your birth mark!

scripts.speaker: Friendly-Looking Man
scripts.text:
You don't have to listen to a guy right next to my room.
Two years ago, he was in a mercenary training center and fell off from a tree
while trying to gather a nut from it.

scripts.speaker: Friendly-Looking Man
scripts.text:
He keeps talking to himself loud and it gives me a headache...
Gosh!

scripts.speaker: Fussy Man
scripts.text:
Aaaaarrrggghhh...I AM IN TROUBLE!
My little chicken has left me!
Oh, my god! Oh, my god!
What do you call the chicken?

scripts.speaker: Fussy Man
scripts.text:
I used to call it 'Amazing Picky'...
*Sob* What should I do! How could this happen!
Please, please help me to find my sweet little chicken!
What? That is such a boring name!

scripts.speaker: Fussy Man
scripts.text:
Don't be so ridiculous!
'Amazing Picky' is the most wonderful and the most unique name
in this world, and my chicken deserves the name!

scripts.speaker: Fussy Man
scripts.text:
You don't care, do you?
I am only child in my family, so I have been thinking of my little chicken as my brother!
I want my chicken back...*Sob*

scripts.speaker: Fussy Man
scripts.text:
You don't care, do you?
I am only child in my family, so I have been thinking of my little chicken as my brother!
I want my chicken back...*Sob*

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text:
The Kafra Corporation Headquarters is located here in Al De Baran.
Do you know
what that means?

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text: That means those cute Kafra Employees come here for their lunch breaks! Isn't that great?!

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text:
Alright, then!
Pop Quiz Time!
Who's your
favorite Kafra girl?

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text: Oh, and don't worry. I know that girls have some kind of opinion about how pretty other girls are.
Awesome!
No way, I ain't a perv.

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text:
Alright, here we go!
Choose your favorite Kafra Lady!

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text: The original Kafra Mascot, the classic blue haired lady! Candidate Number One: ^3355FFPavianne^000000!

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text: Her graceful ponytail takes men's breath away! The fan favorite amongst teen males! Candidate Number Two: ^5533FFBlossom^000000!

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text: Her long, straight hair, like silk from the East, is her charm point. Direct from Payon, it's Candidate Number Three: ^555555Jasmine^000000!

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text: A tomboy with bright orange, shortly cut hair. Candidate Number Four: ^1133DDRoxie^000000!

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text: Intelligent, sophisticated and never seen without her luxurious glasses. It's Candidate Number Five: ^33FF55Leilah^000000!

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text:
Pretty, cute and fresh faced. Although She looks young and immature, she's the best staff!
Candidate Number (6) ^AAAA00Curly Sue^000000 !!
(1) Pavianne
(2) Blossom
(3) Jasmine
(4) Roxie
(5) Leilah
(6) Curly Sue

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text:
Oh~
So you're a lover of classics. I respect that very much.

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text: I'll also guess that you tend to enjoy the original movie more than sequels, and dislike bad imitations. Am I right?

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
Blossom strikes me as the girl-next-door type. So I guess that's the type of girl you're attracted to, eh?

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text:
So...
Long, luxurious hair is important to you, hmm? I suppose it such hair makes a woman look quite elegant.

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text: Ah, so you tend to like active, spontaneous types. I can understand that...

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text: Since Roxie isn't exactly the demure housewife type, you probably have an open mind when it comes to defining femininity, right?

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text: Ah, so you like the intellectual type. That's good, that's good.

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text: Still, that Leilah can be cold as stone sometimes. I've seen her shrug off many young men and crush even more hearts!

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text:
Say whaaat?!
She's too young!

scripts.speaker: Master
scripts.text: But I worked so hard on this delightful survey! Come now, be a sport! Admiring a pretty woman is like appreciating fine art.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Pavianne
scripts.text:
Welcome! I'm Pavianne,
one of the senior Kafra Employees. The Kafra Corporation Service is always trying to satisfy 100 % of our customers' expectations.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Pavianne
scripts.text: Due to a change in customer support policy, we no longer accept Kafra Passes. However, we are offering refunds for our customers who still possess these passes.
Sell Kafra Pass
Alright, bye~

scripts.speaker: Kafra Pavianne
scripts.text:
I'm sorry,
but you don't
have any Kafra Passes.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Pavianne
scripts.text:
Let's see...
You have 1 Kafra Pass.
You can sell that pass to us for 2000 zeny. Would you like to sell this Kafra Pass back to the Kafra Corporation?

scripts.speaker: Kafra Pavianne
scripts.text:
Let's see...
You have {0} Kafra Passes.
If you want to sell them to us, you will receive {1} zeny. Would you like to sell these back to the Kafra Corporation?
Yes
No

scripts.speaker: Kafra Pavianne
scripts.text: I'm sorry, but you don't have any Kafra Passes.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Pavianne
scripts.text: Thank you.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Pavianne
scripts.text:
Thank you,
have a good day.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Blossom
scripts.text:
Welcome to the
Kafra Corporation.
The Kafra Employees are
always here to serve you.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Blossom
scripts.text: We appreciate your continued use of the Kafra Service. Please feel free to ask me if you have any questions.
How does Kafra Storage work?
How do you teleport people?

scripts.speaker: Kafra Blossom
scripts.text: Well, adventurers like yourself can place items into Kafra Storage, so that you don't have to carry all of your stuff around.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Blossom
scripts.text: Now, the Kafra Storage Window is separated into three tabs into which items are automatically sorted.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Blossom
scripts.text: The ^3355FFItem^000000, ^3355FFEquip^000000, and ^3355FFEtc^000000 tabs work just like the tabs in your character Item Inventory.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Blossom
scripts.text: Multiple items of the same type will only take up one Slot in the Item and Etc. tabs. For example, 324 Jellopies would take up only one Slot, and 22 Red Potions would take another Slot.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Blossom
scripts.text: However, in the Equip tab, each and every single item takes up its own Slot. I guess that's because each and every single equipment can be uniquely upgraded by forging or through Cards.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Blossom
scripts.text: There's a total of 300 Slots for all three item categories in the Kafra Storage, so it might be helpful to remember that.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Blossom
scripts.text: Oh, I get that question all the time. '^CC0066Oh Blossom, how do you do it?^000000' Well...

scripts.speaker: Kafra Blossom
scripts.text: Well, I couldn't really go too much into detail, of course. That's confidential information. But I can tell you our teleportation works through a mix of magic and technology.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Blossom
scripts.text: Also, the Kafra girls alone can't teleport our customers. We just receive and process your teleportation request.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Blossom
scripts.text: Behind the scenes, skilled professionals and technicians are working 24 hours a day to ensure that you teleport quickly and safely to your destination.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Blossom
scripts.text: Anyway, I hope you enjoy your visit here in the Kafra Corporation Headquarters.

scripts.text: As you probably already know, our customers must have at least Basic Skill level 6 in order to use the Kafra Storage.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Roxie
scripts.text: As for the reason for this certain policy, we've had problems with young, fresh faced Novices that would put everything into their Storage.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Roxie
scripts.text: Now you remember your days as a Novice. Everything was new and exciting, but zeny was scarce. Well, a lot of Novices would even put their weapons and armor in Kafra Storage.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Roxie
scripts.text: It's a silly mistake, to be sure, but we here at Kafra Corporation value human life, and decided on the Basic Skill Level 6 Requirement to prevent this kind of mishap.

scripts.speaker: Kafra Roxie
scripts.text: As you may know, the Kafra Corporation has a special relationship with the Merchant Guild, as well as the Blacksmith and Alchemist guilds in Midgard.
